# Additional wildcard contexts

Before any source execution or production edit, the parent requested three
separately named cases for the same nonlinear wildcard policy in sized let and
fold binding. These complement the eighteen first parameter cases without
rewriting their first-source inventory. The negative quantum let must reject;
the zero-iteration ordinary Unit fold must still check its body.
